Got a fight at home?

Describe it in a sentence or two. It can be as small as who gets the last slice. The Refuter turns it into an argument you can test.

Bring a paper

Upload your paper or draft. Claude reconstructs its main argument as premises and a conclusion, and the Refuter goes after it like any classic. You can share it on the public shelf so others attack it too, and see which premise falls most often.

Your file is read in your browser; its text is sent to Claude once to find the argument. Nothing is stored unless you choose to share.

Check the reconstruction

Edit anything Claude got wrong. A faithful reconstruction makes for a better fight.

Write your own

Any belief can be written as a few claims that lead to a conclusion. The Refuter will go after it like the others.

Objections and replies are written live by Claude. They are sparring partners, not authorities; check any source they name before you repeat it.

Disputes are kept in this browser only.
